summary: Eagle Point Credit Co filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose management's unaudited estimate of the range of net asset value per common share as of June 30, 2026 ($4.45–$4.55), net investment income per common share ($0.15–$0.19), realized gains/losses per common share (($0.80)–($0.76)), and foreign currency hedging gains/losses per common share ($0.01–$0.05) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine NAV estimate disclosure by a closed-end fund and does not involve any special-situation event, such as a merger, tender, restructuring, or corporate control change. No deal terms or strategic actions are present.
